steps.en: Install the engine and a language data package
steps.zh: 装引擎包和语言数据包

steps.en: Point the CLI at an image and an output basename
steps.zh: 把图片交给命令行，给个输出基名

steps.en: Segments the page into regions and lines, then recognizes each line with the LSTM engine
steps.zh: 把页面切成区块和行，用 LSTM 引擎逐行识别

steps.en: Re-run asking for a structured output format instead of plain text
steps.zh: 重跑一次，改要带位置的输出格式

steps.en: Writes plain text, TSV/hOCR/ALTO/PAGE with coordinates, or a searchable PDF
steps.zh: 交回纯文本、带坐标格式或可搜索 PDF

value.en: OCR on your own CPU, fully offline: machine-readable text plus word-level coordinates, no GPU and no per-page cloud bill
value.zh: 在自己 CPU 上离线完成识别：拿到机器可读文本和词级坐标，不用 GPU、不按页付云费
